EmailTemplate.subject: Promotional Notifications Unsubscribed
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear valued customer,
We hope this email finds you well.
We wanted to reach out to let you know that we have added your contact details to our unsubscribe list, which means you'll no longer receive promotional SMS and email notifications from us.
We take your privacy seriously and understand that your preferences may change over time. We respect your choices regarding the type and frequency of communications you receive from us. Please note that while you will stop receiving promotional offers or updates via SMS or email, however, you will continue to receive important communications from us, such as transactional communication through emails and SMS notifications (System maintenance updates, OTP, transactions) and any important announcements regarding your account.
Should you require any further assistance, please call us on +973 17123456 or email us on support@ilabank.com
Have a great day!
